description: Send legacy IMI entry pages to the canonical explorer
Send legacy IMI pages to the page origin, preserving data URLs
expression: http.host eq "gigapixels.imazen.org" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/d/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/p/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/benchmarks/") and not http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/index.html" "/gigapixel/index.html"}
